svg.title: NET-10-E — Empty session browser
svg.desc: Successful zero-row read. Unchanged list, selected-details, reserved paging, and two-row footer allocations. The grey noninteractive list replacement has one complete black status line. Refresh is focused.

g.text: No active sessions listed. You can host a session or connect directly.
LAN-first. A listing does not guarantee reachability.
One full status line; no headings, dividers, white rows, scrollbar, or row input.
Join selected disabled. Refresh focused. Direct connect remains independent.
Table/footer geometry unchanged. Standard black text; at least 4 logical px padding.
Status and paging allocations stay reserved; hide paging if neither direction exists.
